Read the per-acquisition observation tables

Source: R/read.R
fpc_observations.Rd

One row per field and acquisition: for optical data, every HLS granule with the clear-pixel count, field-mean reflectance and indices, the geometric shift and the quality flags; for radar, every Sentinel-1 acquisition with linear and dB backscatter, platform and relative orbit.

Usage

fpc_observations(
  type = c("optical", "radar"),
  fields = NULL,
  years = NULL,
  from = NULL,
  to = NULL,
  usable_only = TRUE,
  dir = NULL
)

Arguments

type

"optical" or "radar".

fields

Field identifiers ("FPC000123"), or a data frame from fpc_fields(). NULL reads all fields (large: about 4.6 million rows per year).

years

Years to read. NULL reads every year that is in the data folder.

from, to

First and last date (Date or "YYYY-MM-DD") of the periods to keep.

usable_only

For optical data, keep only the records that enter the composites (qa_use: clear, geometric shift of at most one pixel, reflectance in range, no haze).

dir

Data folder. Defaults to fpc_dir().

Value

A data frame. fid links to fpc_fields(); field_id is added.

Examples

d <- fpc_example_dir()
o <- fpc_observations("optical", years = 2022, dir = d)
head(o[, c("field_id", "date", "sensor", "ndvi", "n_clear_px")])
#>    field_id                date sensor      ndvi n_clear_px
#> 1 FPC059432 2022-01-03 16:15:45    S30 0.5895447         62
#> 2 FPC059432 2022-01-07 15:56:04    L30 0.5713150         62
#> 3 FPC059432 2022-01-08 16:15:39    S30 0.5633226         62
#> 4 FPC059432 2022-01-15 15:56:02    L30 0.5702903         62
#> 5 FPC059432 2022-01-18 16:15:38    S30 0.5806054         62
#> 6 FPC059432 2022-01-31 15:55:57    L30 0.3914838         62
